scope: clean public source and separately rebuilt unsigned IPA; no live private configuration read
privacy_defaults: server, token, and secretKey empty in all new profiles
payload_policy: five standard app payload files; no config, preferences, Keychain data, original IPA, or test fixtures
features: redacted logs and in-memory TOML parsing
verification_status: passed local controller/race tests and unsigned release build/default/path audit; independent code reviews found no blocking issue
verified_locally: candidate loopback STCP E2E including auth/TLS rejection, cleanup and in-memory configuration
not_verified: screen locking, network switching, long-term background/battery
distribution: unsigned iOS 15+ arm64 preview; user-authorized signing or existing compatible installation method required
public_history: new repository with one audited root commit; no previous internal history copied
build_privacy: isolated neutral Go module with trimpath, prefix maps, Mach-O debug path stripping; all IPA entries scanned
prior_application_validation: simulator launch; physical device not verified
